stories.title: Trump Media to overhaul crypto treasury strategy after steep Q2 losses
stories.summary: Trump Media & Technology Group posted a $238 million loss for the second quarter, with its crypto-related losses reported at $361 million as its bitcoin holdings shrank in value. The company says it will revamp its crypto treasury strategy in response.
stories.whyItMatters: A high-profile public company's crypto treasury drawdown is a real-world test of how corporate bitcoin bets hold up when prices turn, with implications for other firms following the same playbook.
whatToWatch: Details of the revamped treasury strategy once announced
Further disclosures on the size of remaining bitcoin holdings
questions: What specifically will change in the treasury approach?
How much bitcoin does the company still hold on its balance sheet?

stories.title: Bitcoin's long-term holders accumulate again as price tops $65,000 ahead of US inflation data
stories.summary: On-chain data shows bitcoin's longest-term holders are accumulating again, coinciding with bitcoin trading above $65,000 ahead of this week's US inflation report. Realized volatility has fallen sharply, but options markets still command a premium for downside protection, suggesting traders remain cautious despite the calm.
stories.whyItMatters: Renewed accumulation alongside pricey downside hedges gives a mixed signal on conviction just as a market-moving data release approaches.
whatToWatch: This week's US inflation data release
Whether the accumulation trend by long-term holders continues
Options skew for downside puts in the days ahead
questions: Will the inflation print break the current low-volatility regime?
Is renewed holder accumulation a leading indicator or just a lagging response to the recent price move?

stories.title: TRON's USDT supply hits $87.9B as network processes $2.1T in Q2 transfers: Messari
stories.summary: Messari data cited by Cointelegraph shows Tether (USDT) supply on the TRON network reached $87.9 billion, with the chain processing $2.1 trillion in transfers during the second quarter.
stories.whyItMatters: TRON's scale in stablecoin settlement underscores its role as core payment-rail infrastructure at a time when stablecoin regulation is under active debate.
whatToWatch: Whether USDT supply on TRON keeps growing next quarter
Any regulatory attention to TRON-based stablecoin flows
questions: How does this compare to USDT supply and transfer volume on Ethereum?

stories.title: BTCPay Server offers 3 BTC bounty for return of funds stolen in wallet exploit
stories.summary: BTCPay Server is offering a bounty of 3 bitcoin for the recovery of funds stolen in a wallet exploit, according to Bitcoin Magazine. The report did not specify the size of the theft or how the exploit occurred.
stories.whyItMatters: BTCPay Server is widely used self-hosted payment infrastructure meant to avoid custodial risk, so a wallet exploit tests the security of that self-custody model.
whatToWatch: Whether the bounty leads to recovery of stolen funds
A technical post-mortem explaining how the exploit happened
questions: How was the wallet compromised?
How many users or merchants were affected?

sources.title: BTCPay Server Offers a 3 Bitcoin Bounty for Recovery of Stolen Funds After Wallet Exploit

stories.title: SharpLink posts $1B loss as its $1.7B ether treasury may take 90 days to unwind
stories.summary: SharpLink reported a $1 billion loss and disclosed that its $1.7 billion Ethereum treasury could take up to 90 days to fully convert to cash, according to CryptoSlate.
stories.whyItMatters: The disclosure highlights liquidity risk in corporate crypto treasuries during a drawdown, a key vulnerability of the digital-asset-treasury company model many firms have adopted.
whatToWatch: Whether SharpLink begins converting holdings to cash
Shareholder or regulatory reaction to the disclosure
questions: What specifically drives the 90-day conversion estimate — market depth, lockups, or something else?
Is a sale of ether holdings imminent?

stories.title: Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum's future hinges on quantum security and AI
stories.summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said the network is staking its long-term future on building quantum-resistant security and integrating AI, according to Decrypt.
stories.whyItMatters: Buterin's framing signals where core Ethereum development priorities are headed, relevant to anyone tracking the protocol's long-term technical roadmap.
whatToWatch: Concrete proposals or upgrades implementing quantum-resistant cryptography
Further detail on how AI would be integrated
questions: What is the timeline for quantum-resistance upgrades?
Would AI integration happen at the protocol level or mainly in applications built on Ethereum?

stories.title: Hackers drain $8 million from a crypto exchange in cross-chain attack
stories.summary: A crypto exchange lost $8 million to hackers who carried out a coordinated attack spanning two blockchains, according to Decrypt. The report did not name the exchange or detail how the breach occurred.
stories.whyItMatters: Cross-chain exploits remain a persistent security gap for exchanges, a recurring risk to user funds even as the industry matures.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of which exchange was hit and how
Whether stolen funds are recovered, frozen, or laundered further
questions: Which exchange was targeted?
What vulnerability allowed a coordinated attack across two chains?

stories.summary: Crypto exchange Coinsbuy lost $8 million after attackers executed a coordinated exploit spanning two blockchains, CoinDesk reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Another reminder that exchange security remains uneven industry-wide, with real user funds exposed to coordinated attacks.
whatToWatch: Coinsbuy's response and any reimbursement plan for affected users
Whether other exchanges disclose similar exposure or a linked incident
questions: How did attackers coordinate the exploit across two blockchains?
Will affected users be made whole?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs see inflow spike following major exchange hack
stories.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs saw a jump in inflows following a large crypto exchange hack, according to Bitcoin Magazine, a pattern consistent with investors moving from exchange-custodied crypto toward regulated fund wrappers after security incidents.
stories.whyItMatters: Shifts in ETF flows after hacks are a useful signal of how investors are weighing custody risk against the convenience of holding crypto directly on exchanges.
whatToWatch: Whether the inflow trend continues in coming days
Overall weekly spot bitcoin ETF flow data
questions: How much of the inflow spike is directly attributable to the hack versus other market drivers?

stories.title: Asia crypto roundup: Thailand's 0% crypto tax and a Bitcoin Red Team's AI dilemma
stories.summary: Cointelegraph's Asia Express roundup flagged two items: a zero-percent tax policy on crypto in Thailand, and a report that a Bitcoin-focused "Red Team" security effort was forced to rely on Chinese AI tools. As a roundup, detail on both items is limited.
stories.whyItMatters: Asia continues to be a proving ground for divergent crypto approaches, from tax incentives to security-tooling dependencies with geopolitical overtones.
whatToWatch: Further detail on the scope and duration of Thailand's tax policy
Any follow-up on the Bitcoin Red Team's AI tooling situation
questions: What exactly are the terms of Thailand's 0% crypto tax, and who qualifies?
Why was the Red Team limited to Chinese AI tools, and what are the security implications?

stories.title: Grayscale turns $1.1B in staking rewards into a recurring sale mechanism for ETF holders
stories.summary: Grayscale has converted more than $1.1 billion worth of staked crypto into a recurring reward-sale process for holders of its ETFs, according to CryptoSlate.
stories.whyItMatters: The structure shows how crypto ETF issuers are monetizing staking yield within fund products, a design choice that could shape how regulators treat staking inside ETFs going forward.
whatToWatch: How proceeds from the reward sales are distributed to ETF holders
Whether competing issuers adopt similar structures
questions: What are the tax implications of this reward-sale mechanism for holders?
Does this structure require ongoing regulatory sign-off?

stories.title: Bitdeer nearly quintuples bitcoin mining output in Q2

stories.whyItMatters: A sharp jump in output from a major miner signals capacity expansion and competitive positioning as hash rate and difficulty continue to climb industry-wide.
whatToWatch: Bitdeer's next quarterly results for follow-through
Broader trends in network hash rate and mining difficulty
questions: What drove the fivefold increase — new hardware, facility expansion, or efficiency gains?
How does the output jump affect Bitdeer's cost structure and margins?
